notes: Assumptions that change the number: pork fillet at USDA tenderloin lean-and-fat values, 150 g a person; 800 g peeled butternut and two medium red apples (~165 g cored each); all 2 tbsp oil eaten. Net carbs come mostly from the butternut and apple, not added sugar. Published check: pork tenderloin, apple and squash traybakes are typically listed at ~380–450 kcal a serving; 430 agrees.
